verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack states a training opt-out or data-use policy for Cline. The only route is indirect: running local models via Ollama or LM Studio keeps code and prompts on the machine, and BYOK or self-hosting passes data handling to a provider you choose. This avoids training use by design rather than through a documented opt-out. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training or opt-out policy for Cline's own provider and service, data retention terms, org-level enforcement controls for an engineering lead, and independent corroboration.
